full_details: The almanac said only St George. You had heard of the Garter trumpets at Whitehall, and you were not near them. In the fields you said thirty-one, or Saturday if the font is believed over your mother, and you said your father had a house at that age while you have a chamber, a cat, and a king half-made. You stopped, and you went on into the banishment: six years, no, ten, and then four given back. You laughed without sound. You told nobody. A quire was on the table when you came in, and you wrote no price. Through the afternoon you worked the fourth sheet. The Shrew was the Theatre's bill. You did not go. At evening prayer a book lay on the ledge and you copied nothing out of it.
one_sentence: You said your age to the grass and to nobody else, bought a quire, and stayed at the desk while the Shrew was on at the Theatre.
title: Thirty-one, said to the grass
